notes.title: Networking & Party Improvements
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the ice map buildings didn't have text above them.

notes.title: Major Networking Fix!
notes.content:
Pushed a small update that should hopefully fix network lag and disconnect issues for everyone.

Especially affected by this were people outside of the US. It should hopefully be improved.

I'll continue making networking improvements as this playtest goes along. Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Minor Controller + Load Time Hotfix
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where controller buttons wouldn't work.
[*] Improved load times by removing unnecessary file writes.
[*] Slightly improved the disconnect on load issue for non-US players by reducing load times. (The real fix for this will come later.)
[/list]

notes.title: Fat Goblins Playtest Officially Over! (For now...)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185624/62fb6537a3dde038d3de35773985cd5a7d3d2d8a.png[/img]

Completed for now!

Since this playtest was more balanced, and the playtests bugs and crashes were almost exclusively around server security this time... I actually did learn quite a bit and definitely have a huge amount of improvements I can make over the next few months.

Despite a few issues the playtest performed pretty well even into the end of day 2. Woohoo!

My plans for the next playtest will be once these changes are made, and I've added the dungeon map with the dragon raid boss. I'll either end up doing a small play test to just test the dungeon map, or I'll wait until I have basic bots added into the game and have a longer lasting bot focused playtest. So the focus will either be on the dungeon map or bots.

Stay tuned for [b]the next playtest in a few months[/b], and consider joining the discord for more live updates. Lastly, the playtest schedule should get much more packed leading into early 2025, with more playtests and even a demo version coming soon!
